content: NDT report AI landscape: Sonatest UTLity/UTstudio+ and Zetec UltraVision are instrument-tethered data analysis/reporting tools; DocuMatrix (SPA Innovision India) is an AI Smart Reports product extracting data from photographed handwritten NDT reports; Therness generates ISO/ASNT-compliant NDT procedures. None combine CSV ingestion + code acceptance evaluation + clause-cited reasoning. No vendor positions an LLM acceptance copilot for ASME-style criteria.
